apparatus: Dilute noninteracting point tracers have negligible inertia and move in a prescribed steady incompressible liquid velocity u_x=a sin(y/L0)+c sin(2y/L0), u_y=b sin(x/L0)+d sin(2x/L0), with the component amplitudes in L0/t0. External forcing maintains this field; tracers do not alter it. Their independent molecular displacements have covariance2D dt times the Cartesian identity. The continuum model is dx=u(x)dt+sqrt(2D)dW. There are no reflecting walls, absorption, resetting or selection. The liquid and tracer domain is unbounded; the specified velocity is periodic. Every repetition starts with an independent phase uniformly distributed over one period cell.
readout: Record each tracer displacement in the laboratory without reducing it modulo a period. For the specified Cartesian direction e, report the limit as t/t0 tends to infinity of Var[e dot (X(t)-X(0))]/(2t), in L0^2/t0. All tracers are counted with equal weight.
public_scope: An eventual task would give this apparatus, known velocity and readout; no cell equation, Gaussian sampling diagnosis, closure instruction or implementation restriction. No final public README exists.
calibration_design_private: Nonzero one-leg shears at varied first/second harmonic amplitudes and both orientations; source and physical observable coincide. Four amplitude settings .6,1.2,2,3 with second harmonic .25 times first give a strict inverse-D difference. Fixed instrument sigma has not been chosen; no data generated.
prototype_coverage_qualification: The displayed control box is provisional. This feasibility contains selected structured/reversal cases, not all corners of that box. A future package requires full-domain reference and noisy margin checks before freeze.
